source_refs.evidence_note: Public page lists Basic / Starter / Premium / Ultimate cards, call limits, history depth, and feature groups. It also says FMP data use is subject to Terms of Service and display or redistribution requires a specific display / licensing agreement.

Public Terms page grants access during the subscription period for the account / order-form scope, lists license restrictions, includes confidentiality / retention language, and requires deletion of received / cached data after termination.
Public FAQ states one request counts as one API call and says FMP does not currently offer free trials; this artifact performs no trial, no signup, and no request.

Public stable docs list endpoint templates for financial statements, ratios, key metrics, historical price, dividends, splits, and delisted companies. Listed template does not prove plan entitlement or data quality.

Public docs list Delisted Companies API with endpoint https://financialmodelingprep.com/stable/delisted-companies?page=0&limit=100. This artifact does not call it and does not prove inactive / delisted universe coverage.
Public docs list Stock Split Details API with endpoint https://financialmodelingprep.com/stable/splits?symbol=AAPL. This artifact does not call it and does not validate corporate-action events.

Public docs list Dividends Company API with endpoint https://financialmodelingprep.com/stable/dividends?symbol=AAPL. This artifact does not call it and does not validate dividend fields or total-return treatment.

Public docs list Key Metrics API with endpoint https://financialmodelingprep.com/stable/key-metrics?symbol=AAPL. This does not prove Basic access, SIVB access, or direct availability of every required metric.
Public docs list Financial Ratios API with endpoint https://financialmodelingprep.com/stable/ratios?symbol=AAPL. This does not prove Basic access or ratio lineage.
Public docs list historical EOD price / volume surfaces. This artifact does not call them and does not prove adjustment, delisting, or SIVB access.
Prior diagnostic identified split / dividend templates and kept SIVB HTTP 402 as an open hypothesis before the later re-probe.

Prior license / storage review intentionally used existing repo evidence only and did not refresh current public FMP terms; this artifact fills the public-docs review gap but still gives no legal conclusion.
Tracked summary records SIVB-only 5/5 HTTP 402 with weak historical_or_delisted_paid_tier category signal, no body text / URL / raw rows / secret, and no paid-wall or coverage proof.
User-approved validation authorization records FMP Basic / existing-key / SEC public API / $0 small-sample boundary. This artifact does not broaden that authorization.

pricing_page_limitations: The public pricing page records marketing / plan-summary signals, not endpoint-level proof for SIVB or inactive / delisted coverage.
The page explicitly routes data use to Terms of Service and flags display / redistribution as needing a specific licensing agreement.
The public comparison table includes symbols, icons, and limited-coverage labels that require signed-in or endpoint-specific confirmation before implementation.

public_terms_storage_review.binding_terms_source_note: Binding terms are governed by FMP's actual Terms / subscription / order-form / account terms and any licensing agreement. This artifact records public-page signals only and does not replace user or legal review.

observations.public_text_summary: Terms describe a limited, revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable right to access specified Data and APIs during the subscription period.
observations.plain_meaning_for_this_project: FMP access is plan/account scoped. A pricing card alone is not enough to say our system may store or use all needed data.

observations.public_text_summary: The pricing comparison labels Basic / Starter / Premium / Ultimate usage as Individual and exposes Personal Use / Commercial Use tabs.
observations.plain_meaning_for_this_project: A personal/internal system may fit an individual-use path, but the repo cannot decide that classification for the user.

observations.public_text_summary: Pricing page says display or redistribution of FMP-sourced data requires a specific Data Display and Licensing Agreement.
observations.plain_meaning_for_this_project: Tracked raw rows, public sharing, dashboards, redistribution, or display beyond private summaries need separate review.

observations.public_text_summary: Terms include license restrictions, confidentiality language, and termination / deletion obligations for Data and cached data.
observations.plain_meaning_for_this_project: Long-term local raw caches and DataHub-normalized storage remain blocked until retention and deletion duties are judged.

observations.public_text_summary: Terms state license rights terminate on termination and require ceasing use of services and Data / derived information.
observations.plain_meaning_for_this_project: The system must not assume FMP data can be kept forever after subscription/account changes.

observations.public_text_summary: Terms include a Data Deletion section requiring deletion of received data, including cached data, after termination and mention FMP audit rights if continued use is suspected.
observations.plain_meaning_for_this_project: Before broad local storage, we need a deletion / retention rule and user acceptance of operational burden.

observations.public_text_summary: Pricing page says data is informational only, errors or omissions may occur, and FMP disclaims liability for inaccuracies.
observations.plain_meaning_for_this_project: Provider data still needs PIT, reconciliation, fallback, and drift checks before use. A paid tier would not remove validation work.

next_steps: If the user wants full inactive / delisted coverage, decide between paid FMP review and alternate-provider review; either path still needs a separate explicit approval and reviewed packet.
If staying with Basic, record an accepted active-only scope or keep SR-PROVIDER-001 open for inactive / delisted coverage; do not silently drop failed inactive symbols.
Before any paid upgrade, trial, account change, or provider contact, create a separate decision artifact with cost ceiling, user approval, and terms / storage acceptance.
Before any Phase 7c use, close or explicitly accept license / storage / PIT / price-adjustment / corporate-action / coverage / fallback / stability blockers.
limitations: This artifact only records what public FMP pages say. It is not legal advice, not a contract interpretation, and not user acceptance of FMP terms.

It performs no FMP API call, no SEC API call, no signup, no purchase, no trial, no account change, no provider contact, no raw read, no raw parse, no provider selection, no DataHub work, and no Phase 7c authorization.
Listed endpoint templates and listed plan features do not prove SIVB access, inactive / delisted coverage, corporate-action correctness, PIT safety, or storage rights.
The SIVB re-probe summary remains only a weak category signal; paid-wall status and paid-tier coverage remain unproven.
